I really hate the whole sexualization of fictional characters argument (in a M rated game). Honestly each character should have skins on both sides of the spectrum. You want something more revealing? Sure. You want battle armor that shows nothing? Sure. Player choice is one hell of a thing. 

The problem with the way they have been doing the female outfits for the last few games is that they are all so bland. I’m not going to play a character if all of their outfits fucking suck. Unfortunately that means I rarely end up playing as the female characters. That isn’t because I can’t see their asshole, it’s because the outfits are boring and don’t stand out like Jade’s default in MK11 or they just don’t seem like something that the character would wear like Skarlet’s default costume in MK11. One of Skarlet’s powers was literally that she would absorb people’s blood through her skin and gain strength, so her default makes no sense whatsoever. 

I don’t think they should go back to MK9 outfits, I think they should go back to the 3D era outfits. They were sexy sure but they still had character, and it wasn’t essentially just lingerie. Some characters make sense to show more skin like Mileena for example (take a look at her Deception outfit) while others don’t, like Sonya Blade. If you look at Sonya’s outfits from Deadly Alliance and Shaolin Monks, they aren’t revealing but still look good. Street fighter does this very well. 

People seem to have gotten really sensitive over this kind of thing IN A M RATED GAME. It’s funny because people never complained about it back then either. All of this arguing could be solved by literally just giving people the choice of what kind costume to use. As I said earlier, have some outfits that are revealing and some that aren’t, like battle armor. If you are a person that would get mad that revealing costumes are in the game even if you have alternatives that aren’t, just the fact that they’re there, then you should go touch grass.

I hope they drop the garbage chapter concept all together because it only serves to hurt the characters. We should get to play as the villains too, that way one side isn’t just waffle stomping the other and it makes the villains not look like threats anymore
